blockers.detail: The full compiler fails to establish a subtraction bound in external-call-unit. A simpler scalar probe accepts the original guard. An explicit positive-bound rewrite is now under a full-source check; it is not yet verified as a repair.
blockers.technical: Candidate 11: bootstrap.check:16879:46 — function precondition is not established at this call. 211 diagnostics include cascades; they are not 211 separate features.
